title: Tree Stumps
description: chop a tree, get a stump - standalone
body:
# Tree Stumps v15.0.0

**Tree felling datapack with configurable stumps, auto-felling, and regrowth.**

### Open the settings menu

```
/trigger ts_trigger set 1
```

## Bugs

- May destroy entire forest if max logs is set very high.


## Usage

Free to use in modpacks and any other projects.

---

## Commands

### Trigger menu shortcuts (non-OP)

These match the clickable buttons in the menu.

```
/trigger ts_trigger set 2   Toggle datapack enabled/disabled
/trigger ts_trigger set 3   Toggle stumps
/trigger ts_trigger set 4   Toggle auto-fell trees
/trigger ts_trigger set 5   Toggle clear leaves
/trigger ts_trigger set 6   Toggle ignore player-placed logs
/trigger ts_trigger set 7   Toggle stump regrow
/trigger ts_trigger set 8   Increase max logs (+50)
/trigger ts_trigger set 9   Decrease max logs (-50)
/trigger ts_trigger set 10  Regrow time preset: Sapling (30s)
/trigger ts_trigger set 11  Regrow time preset: 1 Day (24000 ticks)
/trigger ts_trigger set 12  Increase regrow time (+1 minute)
/trigger ts_trigger set 13  Decrease regrow time (-1 minute)
/trigger ts_trigger set 14  Toggle stump detection
/trigger ts_trigger set 19  Max logs preset: Low (50)
/trigger ts_trigger set 20  Max logs preset: Medium (250)
/trigger ts_trigger set 21  Max logs preset: High (5000)
/trigger ts_trigger set 22  Toggle messages
```

### Direct config functions (OP/admin)

```
/function treestumps:config/menu
/function treestumps:config/toggle_enabled
/function treestumps:config/toggle_stumps
/function treestumps:config/toggle_fell
/function treestumps:config/toggle_leaves
/function treestumps:config/toggle_placed
/function treestumps:config/toggle_regrow
/function treestumps:config/toggle_detect_stumps
/function treestumps:config/limit_up
/function treestumps:config/limit_down
/function treestumps:config/regrow_sapling
/function treestumps:config/regrow_1day
/function treestumps:config/regrow_time_up
/function treestumps:config/regrow_time_down
/function treestumps:config/toggle_messages
```

### Max logs presets

These set the max logs felled per tree and re-open the menu.

```
/function treestumps:config/limit_low (50)
/function treestumps:config/limit_medium (250)
/function treestumps:config/limit_high (5000)
```

## Notes

- Most settings are easiest to change via the menu.
- Stump detection helps existing stumps regrow after world reload.
- Works with all vanilla wood types including pale oak.
